subject: general
question:
Find the number of triangles in the given figure. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab7d03074983bf87908c3ab801ec924867779ce520c81fff43532989695cda3a.png]
solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8048a35180569849c73078ad17091d54e2cea28e4d5d8abe71460ffba90cbccf.png] 

[Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = Total triangles

= [3 × (1 + 3)] ÷ 2

= [3 × 4] ÷ 2

= 12 ÷ 2

= 6

Here, there are a total of 6 triangles.

Hence, **"6"** is the correct answer.
